csv_project_name: Conslt for Multiple Service Agreements for Environmental Svc
csv_scope_of_work: Los Angeles World Airports (LAWA) is issuing this Request for Qualifications ( RFQ ) to solicit Statements of Qualifications ( SOQ ) from qualified firms ( Respondents ) to prequalify three Benches of on-call services related to environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning services as described in Section 5. These Benches are intended to select qualified environmental firms to provide as-needed professional services to support LAWA s ongoing and anticipated environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning needs via competitive Task Order Solicitation (TOS) procurements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Energy Engineering

short_description: On-call environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning services for Los Angeles World Airports.
project_scope: Request for qualifications to prequalify three benches of on-call consultants for as-needed task orders supporting LAWA's ongoing and anticipated environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning needs. Disciplines requested include geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, land use planning, planning/master planning, biological studies/natural resources, environmental engineering/planning/design, and energy engineering. Base period 36 months with 24-month renewal option. Multiple contracts may be awarded.
services: On-call environmental services, sustainability consulting, energy engineering, planning/master planning, land use planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, biological studies/natural resources, geotechnical engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an on-call environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning services RFQ.
- No defined bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural project.
- Disciplines are largely outside sbp's core structural engineering focus.
- Explicitly resembles framework/on-call consulting without technical structural specification, which is low priority for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice is for multiple on-call service agreements with task-order-based procurement, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms must submit statements of qualifications for prequalification to provide on-call professional services in environmental, sustainability, energy, and planning disciplines. Specific reference counts or minimum project qualifications are not stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: Prequalification via RFQ for multiple benches of qualified firms; detailed award criteria or weighting are not stated in the provided text.
